runSummary.stalePolicy: LIVE eligibility requires real source verification and link evidence. Content age and source-verification age are separate; touching updatedAt alone never makes a job fresh.
runSummary.note: Fresh 13.9.2026 00:38 public-web sweep across 13 actually searched source families. No new promotion-grade unique job passed ranking and evidence gates, so jobs-data.json remains fail-closed at 52 LIVE items. Profesia surfaced a minutes-old partner Telekom customer-care role and Henkel Coordinator Digital Marketing, but the former is primarily sales-oriented and the latter requires fluent English. Direct Henkel canonical verification also found International Team Assistant in Bratislava at 1,500-1,950 EUR, but it explicitly requires English C1 and at least two years of executive/management-assistant experience. LinkedIn surfaced KLARSTEIN Italian-language customer support, Foxelli remote support with fluent/near-native English and crochet specialization, and SupportYourApp fluent-English support; none passed. Upwork surfaced WordPress/e-commerce/VA work, but visible candidates were rejected for C1/excellent English, low 3-8 USD/h economics, fixed-price underpayment, expert/development scope or high competition. Facebook public indexing yielded 0 concrete verifiable hiring posts with direct links.

developmentChanges.title: Relative publish-time rollover guard
developmentChanges.reason: Capture the exact audit timestamp and convert labels such as '4 minutes ago', 'yesterday' or '1 day ago' into an absolute publishedAt with source timezone evidence. This prevents midnight/date-rollover errors that can incorrectly boost or demote <24h priority jobs.

developmentChanges.title: Fresh-role competition density signal
developmentChanges.reason: For sources exposing applicant/proposal counts, persist competition at first discovery and recheck it on subsequent runs. Rank equally strong roles higher when they are both fresh and still lightly contested, improving response probability without weakening skill or locality gates.
